name: skill-rentgen

network.purpose: download the repository you asked to scan
network.when: only when you give a https://github.com address

network.purpose: ask for the newest commit id of a repository you recorded as a source
network.when: only with adopt --source, add with a GitHub address, or check --upstream

hooks.purpose: one line if a skill you approved has changed. A small script that reads the registry and hashes files; it cannot scan, install, block or use the network

writes_outside_skill_dir: ./skill-rentgen-report/ in the folder you run it from, or the folder given with --out
~/.skill-rentgen/registry.json and state.json: the record of what you approved, and when it was last checked
~/.claude/skills/<name>/ or ./.claude/skills/<name>/: only the add command, only a skill that passed the scan, and only the bytes that were scanned
./.claude/settings.local.json: only the block and unblock commands, only with --yes, and only the two deny rules for the skill you name
a temporary quarantine folder, removed when the scan ends
a temporary copy of the skill for a trial run, mounted read-only into the container and removed when the run ends
subprocess: python3, for its own isolated stages
docker or podman, only for the trial command: one container with no network, removed at the end
cpd (claude-plugin-doctor), only with inventory --doctor and only if you installed it
